text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day. In order to give her a 
chance to unwind, as she had been pushing 
herself a bit too hard lately, I gave her 
the day off from training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I picked up my pen to update my 
4-koma blog—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Are you free today?
choice_data_list: I don't really have any particular plans.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, if you're ready. There's a 
place I'd like to take you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The track.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Since it was my day off, I was doing some 
self-training, but—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, having someone there to watch over 
you really is the best way to be, I think.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I would like to ask you to record my time 
and check my form. Would that be all 
right?"
choice_data_list: No, I just wanted you to get some rest...
No, I just wanted you to get some rest...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho is right upon us. There is no 
time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"This winter, Machan wants to get totally 
ripped. Therefore, strict and relentless 
training today without rest as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The notebook she handed over was filled 
with a list of various training menus.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I wanted her to rest... she isn't 
the type to listen. So, I decided to help 
her out instead.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, haah... Alright, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hm, it's the New Year's Special Series, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but what should we do? Time-wise, 
doing just one might be our limit.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Then I'll leave it to you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Between the giant kite-flying dash, 
making a wish at the shrine, and 'Machan 
Hyakunin Isshu,' which one would you 
prefer?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For now, the one that instinctively 
clicked was—
choice_data_list: Make a wish at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great. I'm glad the giant octopus 
didn't go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll get things ready. Please wait a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And what she hauled back with her was... 
an octopus roughly four meters wide!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The cord tied around my waist is 
custom-made. If it were too thin, it would 
snap while running.
choice_data_list: A kite-flying dash... could that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's training where I run with 
a kite tied to my waist!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It's built so splendidly, I'm sure it 
will soar through the sky with ease."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If it were possible, I was thinking it'd 
be nice if Chan-chan could fly a little 
too, together with you. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...With faint hopes lingering in our 
minds, training began, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Scritch, scritch, scritch...)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh. Low-altitude flight. Am I lacking 
in speed, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll try running even faster, with a whole 
lot of 'zoom'...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, New Year's Day came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to sprint through another whole 
year by her side with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I understand. Making a wish, I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Alright, let us head to the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...There are quite a lot of people, aren't 
there?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. That is indeed how New 
Year's Day works.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hatsumode... If so, would you like to go, 
Trainer? Or have you already gone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we ended up praying side by side――

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: What did you wish for?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I prayed earnestly for Aston Machan's 
health and continued success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, New Year's Day came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to sprint through another whole 
year by her side with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that sounds lovely. Let's do 
it—'Chan-Hyakunin Isshu'!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"‘Mar-chan Hyakunin Isshu’ is the Mar-chan 
version of ‘Umamusume Hyakunin Isshu.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With barely any explanation, I was taken 
to the gym and handed the reading cards.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now, Chan-me will run, so please call them 
out randomly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The actual rules are the same as 
"Umamusume Hyakunin Isshu", where you 
split into card-grabbers and callers, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Since it's just Machan and Trainer-san 
right now, it'll be special rules.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's a game where Trainer 
reads something, and Machan goes to fetch 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, she looks like she's 
having fun, so all's well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waiting until everyone is ready, I shuffle 
the cards at hand, recite the introductory 
poem according to the rules, and then read 
out the opening phrase.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Ma' card for Mar-chan, I see. You've 
got great luck, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The full text reads: "Run, dear Chan-chan, 
run as far as you can go."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Lovely Dash, Swift as the Wind" ...it is!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yay, I got it~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, New Year's Day came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to sprint through another whole 
year by her side with all my might!
